name: G16 Control
author: omarchy-asus
description: ASUS ROG Zephyrus G16 in one Omarchy panel: keyboard and lid Slash LEDs, per-charger keyboard, refresh rate, backlight and CPU power limits, battery charge limit, Fn+Super. Event-driven, one bundled Python bridge, nothing to install on stock Omarchy. Part of omarchy-asus (kernel, NVIDIA and Omarchy fixes for ASUS ROG laptops).

barWidget.description: Zephyrus G16 hardware in one panel: keyboard and lid Slash LEDs, panel refresh rate, and battery charge ceiling
